mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_organization (org_id, tenant_id, name, parent_org_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{orgId}, #{tenantId}, #{name}, #{parentOrgId}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT org_id, tenant_id, name, parent_org_id, created_at, updated_at FROM iam_organization WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY created_at
